summary: The article accurately reports Signature Global's Q1 FY27 pre-sales figures and their quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year changes, along with the key driver for the QoQ growth. The information aligns with multiple financial news sources.

claims.claim: Signature Global reported pre-sales of ₹1,970 crore for Q1 FY27, indicating strong operational activity.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm Signature Global's Q1 FY27 pre-sales at ₹1,970 crore.

claims.claim: This figure represents a robust 25% quarter-on-quarter (QoQ) growth, suggesting positive momentum.
claims.note: Livemint and other financial news outlets confirm a 25% QoQ growth in pre-sales for Q1 FY27.

claims.claim: However, the pre-sales were 25% lower on a year-on-year (YoY) basis compared to Q1 FY26.
claims.note: ET Realty and Livemint both state a 25% YoY decline in pre-sales for Q1 FY27 compared to Q1 FY26.

claims.claim: The launch of Tonino Lamborghini Residences was a significant contributor to the QoQ sales surge.
claims.note: Livemint and other sources explicitly mention the successful launch of Tonino Lamborghini Residences as a driver for the QoQ sales increase.

claims.claim: Signature Global's net debt stood at ₹390 crore at the end of Q1 FY27, compared to ₹200 crore at the end of FY26.
claims.note: Business Standard and other financial news articles confirm these net debt figures for Signature Global.

article_title: Signature Global Q1 FY27 Pre-Sales: A Closer Look at Growth
